name: google_search
description: Search the web and return the top results. Use for facts you do not know or that may have changed.

query.description: The search query, as you would type it into a search box.

name: click_at
description: Click at a point of the attached screen frame. Coordinates are normalised to the frame: 0 is the left/top edge, 999 the right/bottom edge.

name: type_at
description: Click the text field at a point of the attached frame (normalised 0-999), type text into it, and optionally press Enter.

press_enter.description: Whether to press Enter after typing.

name: scroll
description: Scroll the focused page or view by one screen in a direction.

name: press_key
description: Press one key or one keyboard shortcut from a fixed list (for example Enter, Ctrl+C or Alt+Tab).

combo.description: The key or shortcut; modifiers are held while the last key is pressed.

name: page_overview
description: Shows one picture of the whole web page, scaled down to fit the screen, so you can see what lies beyond the visible part. The picture is for looking only: click_at and type_at coordinates always refer to the browser screen.
